readings.title: Judgment for Idolatry
readings.subtitle: The Days of Punishment Have Come
readings.text: [Hosea 9:1] O Yisra’ěl, do not rejoice with exultation like the peoples, for you have whored from your <dn>Elohim</dn>. You have loved a harlot-fee at <dn>את</dn> all threshing-floors. [2] Threshing floor and winepress shall not feed them, and new wine shall fail in her. [3] They shall not dwell in the land of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, but Ephrayim shall return to Mitsrayim, and eat unclean food in Ashshur. [4] They do not pour wine offerings to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, nor are they pleasing to <dn>Him</dn>. Their slaughterings are like bread of mourners to them, all who eat it are defiled. For their bread is for their beings, it does not come into the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [5] What do you do for the Day of Appointment, and in the day of the Festival of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>? [6] For look, they shall go because of destruction – Mitsrayim gathers them up, Moph buries them, nettles possess their valuables of silver, thorns are in their tents. [7] The days of punishment have come, the days of retribution have come. Yisra’ěl knows! The prophet is a fool, the ‘man of the Spirit’ is mad, because of the greatness of your crookedness, and great is the enmity. [8] <dn>Elohim</dn>’s watchman over you, Ephrayim, is the prophet, but a trapper’s snare is in all his ways. Enmity is in the House of his <dn>Elohim</dn>. [9] They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gib‛ah. <dn>He</dn> remembers <dn>את</dn> their crookedness, <dn>He</dn> punishes their sins. [10] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> found <dn>את</dn> Yisra’ěl like grapes in the wilderness. <dn>I</dn> saw <dn>את</dn> your fathers as the first-fruits on the fig tree in its beginning. They themselves have gone to Ba‛al Pe‛or, and separated themselves to shame, and became as abominable as that which they loved.</dq> [11] <dq>“Ephrayim is like a bird, their esteem has flown away – no birth, and none with child, and no conception!</dq> [12] <dq>“Though they bring up their children, <dn>I</dn> shall make them childless, without man. For it is woe to them when <dn>I</dn> turn away from them!</dq> [13] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> have seen Ephrayim, like Tsor, planted in a pleasant place. But Ephrayim shall bring out his children to the killer.”</dq> [14] Give them, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> – give what? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts. [15] <dq>“All their evil is in Gilgal, for there <dn>I</dn> have hated them. Because of the evil of their deeds <dn>I</dn> drive them from <dn>My</dn> house, no more do <dn>I</dn> love them. All their rulers are rebels.</dq> [16] <dq>“Ephrayim has been stricken, their root has dried up, they yield no fruit. Even if they bear children, <dn>I</dn> shall put to death <dn>את</dn> the precious ones of their womb.”</dq> [17] <dn>My</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> rejects them, because they have not obeyed <dn>Him</dn>, so that they become wanderers among the nations!

readings.title: The Degenerate Vine
readings.subtitle: Judgment Springs Up Like Poisonous Weeds
readings.text: [Hosea 10:1] Yisra’ěl is a degenerate vine, he brings forth fruit for himself. As his fruit increased, he increased the slaughter-places. And the better his land, the better they made the pillars. [2] Their heart has been slippery, now they are guilty. <dn>He</dn> breaks down <dn>את</dn> their slaughter-places, <dn>He</dn> destroys <dn>את</dn> their pillars. [3] For now they say, “We have no sovereign, because we did not fear <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. What would the sovereign do for us?” [4] They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant. Therefore judgment shall spring up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field. [5] The inhabitants of Shomeron fear because of the calf of Běyth Aven. For its people shall mourn for it, as well as its priests who used to rejoice over it, because of its esteem that has departed from it. [6] It is also brought to Ashshur as a present for Sovereign Yarěḇ. Ephrayim does receive shame, and Yisra’ěl is put to shame through his counsel. [7] Shomeron is cut off, her sovereign is like a twig on the surface of the water. [8] And the high places of Aven, the sin of Yisra’ěl, shall be destroyed, thorn and thistle come up on their slaughter-places. And they shall say to the mountains, “Cover us!” and to the hills, “Fall on us!” [9] <dq>“O Yisra’ěl, you have sinned from the days of Gib‛ah. There they stood! The battle in Gib‛ah against the children of perversity did not overtake them.</dq> [10] <dq>“When <dn>I</dn> desire, then <dn>I</dn> bind them. And peoples shall be gathered against them when <dn>I</dn> bind them for their double guilt.</dq> [11] <dq>“And Ephrayim is a trained heifer, loving to thresh grain. But <dn>I</dn> Myself shall pass over her comely neck – <dn>I</dn> put <dn>את</dn> Ephrayim to the yoke, Yehuḏah ploughs, Ya‛aqoḇ harrows for him.”</dq> [12] Sow for yourselves righteousness, reap according to loving-commitment, break up your tillable ground, it is time to seek <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, till <dn>He</dn> comes and rains righteousness on you. [13] You have ploughed wrongness, you have reaped unrighteousness, you have eaten <dn>את</dn> the fruit of lying, because you trusted in your own way, in your many mighty men. [14] And uproar shall arise among your people, and all your strongholds shall be ravaged as Shalman ravaged Běyth Arběl in the day of battle – a mother dashed in pieces on her children. [15] Thus it shall be done to you, O Běyth Ěl, because of the evil of your wickedness. At dawn the sovereign of Yisra’ěl is completely cut off!

readings.title: YeHoVaH's Enduring Love for Yisra’ěl
readings.subtitle: How Could I Give You Up, Ephrayim?
readings.text: [Hosea 11:1] <dq>“When Yisra’ěl was a child, <dn>I</dn> loved him, and out of Mitsrayim <dn>I</dn> called <dn>My</dn> son.</dq> [2] <dq>“They called to them, so they went from their face. They slaughtered to the Ba‛als, and burned incense to carved images.</dq> [3] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> taught <dn>את</dn> Ephrayim to walk, taking them by their arms, but they did not know that <dn>I</dn> healed them.</dq> [4] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> drew them with ropes of man, with cords of love, and <dn>I</dn> was to them as those who take <dn>את</dn> the yoke from their neck. And <dn>I</dn> bent down, fed them.</dq> [5] <dq>“No, let him return to the land of Mitsrayim, and let Ashshur be his sovereign, because they refused to repent!</dq> [6] <dq>“And the sword shall whirl in his cities, and it shall demolish his gate bars, and consume, because of their own counsels.</dq> [7] <dq>“<dn>My</dn> people are bent towards backsliding from <dn>Me</dn>. Though they call to the One Above, none of them exalt <dn>Him</dn>.</dq> [8] <dq>“How could <dn>I</dn> give you up, Ephrayim? How could <dn>I</dn> hand you over, Yisra’ěl? How could <dn>I</dn> make you like Aḏmah? How could <dn>I</dn> set you like Tseḇoyim? <dn>My</dn> heart turns within <dn>Me</dn>, all <dn>My</dn> compassion is kindled.</dq> [9] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> shall not let the heat of <dn>My</dn> wrath burn, <dn>I</dn> shall not turn to destroy Ephrayim. For <dn>I</dn> am Ěl, and not man, the Set-apart One in your midst, and <dn>I</dn> shall not come in enmity.</dq> [10] <dq>“Let them follow <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. Like a lion <dn>He</dn> roars. When <dn>He</dn> roars, then sons shall tremble from the west.</dq> [11] <dq>“They shall tremble like a bird from Mitsrayim, and like a dove from the land of Ashshur. And <dn>I</dn> shall let them dwell in their own houses,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.title: Ephrayim's Deceit and Ya‛aqoḇ's Example
readings.subtitle: Return to Your Elohim
readings.text: [Hosea 11:12] <dq>“Ephrayim has surrounded <dn>Me</dn> with lying, and the house of Yisra’ěl with deceit. But Yehuḏah is still wandering with Ěl, and is true to the Set-apart One.”</dq> [Hosea 12:1] Ephrayim is feeding on wind, and pursuing an east wind. All the day he increases falsehood and ruin. And they make a covenant with Ashshur, and oil is sent to Mitsrayim. [2] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has a controversy with Yehuḏah, to punish <dn>את</dn> Ya‛aqoḇ according to his ways, to repay him according to his deeds. [3] <dn>He</dn> took <dn>את</dn> his brother by the heel in the womb, and in his strength he strove with <dn>את</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn>. [4] <dn>He</dn> strove with <dn>את</dn> the Messenger and overcame, he wept and sought <dn>His</dn> favour. <dn>He</dn> found <dn>Him</dn> in Běyth Ěl, and there <dn>He</dn> spoke to us – [5] even <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of hosts, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is <dn>His</dn> remembrance. [6] Therefore, return to your <dn>Elohim</dn>. Guard loving-commitment and right-ruling, and wait on your <dn>Elohim</dn> continually. [7] A merchant! In his hand are scales of deceit, he loved to oppress. [8] And Ephrayim says, “Indeed, <dn>I</dn> have become rich, <dn>I</dn> have found wealth for myself. In all my labours they shall find in me no crookedness that is sin.” [9] <dq>“But <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> since the land of Mitsrayim, again <dn>I</dn> shall make you dwell in tents as in the days of the appointed time.</dq> [10] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> have spoken to the prophets, and have increased visions. And through the prophets <dn>I</dn> gave parables.”</dq> [11] Is Gil‛aḏ wicked? Certainly, they have been false! In Gilgal they have slaughtered bulls. Also their slaughter-places are as heaps on a ploughed field. [12] And when Ya‛aqoḇ fled to the country of Aram, Yisra’ěl served for a wife, and for a wife he kept watch. [13] And by a prophet <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> brought <dn>את</dn> Yisra’ěl out of Mitsrayim, and by a prophet he was watched over. [14] Ephrayim has provoked most bitterly. So his Master left <dn>את</dn> his blood-guilt on him, and repaid him for his reproach.

readings.title: Ephrayim's Inevitable Ruin
readings.subtitle: You Have Destroyed Yourself, O Yisra’ěl
readings.text: [Hosea 13:1] When Ephrayim spoke there was trembling, he was lifted up in Yisra’ěl. But through Ba‛al he became guilty, and he died. [2] And now they sin more and more, and make for themselves moulded images from their silver, idols according to their skill, all of them the work of craftsmen. They say of them, “Let the men who slaughter kiss <dn>את</dn> the calves!” [3] Therefore they shall be like a morning cloud, and like dew that goes away early, like chaff blown off from a threshing-floor, and like smoke from a window. [4] <dq>“But <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> since the land of Mitsrayim, and an <dn>Elohim</dn> besides <dn>Me</dn> you shall not know, for there is no Saviour besides <dn>Me</dn>.</dq> [5] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> knew you in the wilderness, in the land of drought.</dq> [6] <dq>“When they were fed they were satisfied. They were satisfied and their heart was exalted, therefore they forgot <dn>Me</dn>.</dq> [7] <dq>“So <dn>I</dn> am become like a lion to them, like a leopard <dn>I</dn> watch by the way,</dq> [8] <dq>like a bear robbed of her young <dn>I</dn> attack them and rip open <dn>את</dn> the enclosure of their heart. And there <dn>I</dn> devour them like a lion, a wild beast tear them apart.</dq> [9] <dq>“You have destroyed yourself, O Yisra’ěl, but your help is in <dn>Me</dn>.</dq> [10] <dq>“Where is your sovereign now to save you in all your cities, and <dn>את</dn> your rulers of whom you said, ‘Give me a sovereign and rulers’?</dq> [11] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> gave you <dn>את</dn> a sovereign in <dn>My</dn> displeasure, but <dn>I</dn> took him away in <dn>My</dn> wrath.</dq> [12] <dq>“The crookedness of Ephrayim is bound up, his sin is hidden.</dq> [13] <dq>“Pains of a woman in labour shall come upon him. <dn>He</dn> is not a wise son, for it is not the time that he should delay at the breaking forth of children.</dq> [14] <dq>“From the power of She’ol <dn>I</dn> ransom them, from death <dn>I</dn> redeem them. Where is your plague, O Death? Where is your destruction, O She’ol? Repentance is hidden from <dn>My</dn> eyes.</dq> [15] <dq>“Though he bears fruit among his brothers, an east wind comes, a wind from <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> comes up from the wilderness, and it dries up his fountain, and his spring becomes dry – it plunders <dn>את</dn> a treasure of all desirable objects.</dq> [16] “Shomeron is held guilty, for she has rebelled against her <dn>Elohim</dn> – they fall by the sword, their infants are dashed in pieces, and their pregnant women ripped open.”

readings.title: A Call to Repentance and Promise of Restoration
readings.subtitle: Return to YeHoVaH Your Elohim
readings.text: [Hosea 14:1] O Yisra’ěl, return to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, for you have stumbled by your crookedness. [2] Take words with you, and return to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. Say to <dn>Him</dn>, “Take away <dn>את</dn> all crookedness, and accept what is good, and we render the bulls of our lips. [3] “Ashshur does not save us. We do not ride on horses, nor ever again do we say to the work of our hands, ‘Our mighty ones.’ For the fatherless finds compassion in <dn>You</dn>.” [4] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> shall heal their backsliding, <dn>I</dn> shall love them spontaneously, for <dn>My</dn> displeasure has turned away from him.</dq> [5] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> shall be like the dew to Yisra’ěl. <dn>He</dn> shall blossom like the lily, and strike out his roots like Leḇanon.</dq> [6] <dq>“<dn>His</dn> branches shall spread, and his splendour shall be like an olive tree, and his fragrance like Leḇanon.</dq> [7] <dq>“Those who dwell under his shadow shall return. They shall revive like grain, and blossom like the vine, and become as fragrant as the wine of Leḇanon.</dq> [8] <dq>“What more has Ephrayim to do with idols? It is <dn>I</dn> who answer and look after him. <dn>I</dn> am like a green cypress tree, your fruit comes from <dn>Me</dn>.”</dq> [9] Who is wise and understands these words, discerning and knows them? For the ways of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> are straight, and the righteous walk in them, but the transgressors stumble in them.
